description: This file defines the InsightsBookingBaseService class, which provides methods for retrieving and analyzing booking data, including statistics, trends, and CSV export, with complex filtering and authorization logic.

classes.name: InsightsBookingBaseService
classes.description: A service class providing methods for retrieving booking insights, statistics, and CSV data with complex filtering, authorization, and data transformation logic.

methods.name: getBookingsByHourStats
methods.description: Retrieves booking counts grouped by hour, adjusted for timezone.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches all bookings with optional selected fields.

methods.name: getBaseConditions
methods.description: Constructs the base SQL conditions combining authorization and filters.

methods.name: getAuthorizationConditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on user permissions and scope.

methods.name: buildFilterConditions
methods.description: Creates SQL conditions from column filters.

methods.name: buildColumnFilterCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition for a specific column filter.

methods.name: buildOrgAuthorizationCondition
methods.description: Builds authorization SQL for organization scope.

methods.name: buildTeamAuthorizationCondition
methods.description: Builds authorization SQL for team scope.

methods.name: getCsvData
methods.description: Exports booking data as CSV with related details, including attendee info.

methods.name: getEventTrendsStats
methods.description: Retrieves booking trend statistics over specified date ranges.

methods.name: getPopularEventsStats
methods.description: Fetches most popular event types based on booking counts.

methods.name: getMembersStatsWithCount
methods.description: Gets stats for members with booking counts, sorted by count.

methods.name: getMembersRatingStats
methods.description: Retrieves member ratings statistics.

methods.name: getRecentRatingsStats
methods.description: Fetches recent ratings and feedback for bookings.

methods.name: getBookingStats
methods.description: Provides aggregate booking statistics including counts, ratings, and no-shows.

methods.name: getRecentNoShowGuests
methods.description: Retrieves recent guests who were marked as no-shows.

methods.name: calculatePreviousPeriodDates
methods.description: Calculates date range for the previous period based on current filters.

methods.name: getNoShowHostsOverTimeStats
methods.description: Tracks no-show hosts over time within date ranges.

methods.name: getCSATOverTimeStats
methods.description: Calculates Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores over time.

methods.name: isOwnerOrAdmin
methods.description: Checks if a user has owner or admin permissions for insights access.
